critical_code_review_comments: Static review of /app/frontend/src/components/header.tsx matches requested implementation: About moved into left row with menu, second row removed, HEADER_HEIGHT set to 68, About touch target minHeight 44 and fixed width 56.
Landing scroll offset uses HEADER_HEIGHT in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx (`ys.current[key] - insets.top - HEADER_HEIGHT - 8`), consistent with the requirement for section jumps below header.
All critical header interactions are wired with testIDs, enabling deterministic testing once automation parsing issue is resolved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This run was blocked by automation script parser errors (not app runtime errors). Do not assume pass/fail for the requested header behavior until interactive checks are executed.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: each browser_automation run with multiline Python script failed before execution with `unterminated string literal` (line varied by run). Console logs show app booted normally. Likely runner/script-serialization parsing issue rather than product behavior. Mitigation: use a minimal smoke script to validate parser first, then run full regression script in smaller steps.
